title: Actions: Fix state mutation and keep newest actions when limit reached
body:
- [x] Fix state mutation and retain newest actions when limit reached
- [x] Add container-level ActionLogger stories with play functions
- [x] Fix docs: remove `limit` and `clearOnStoryChange` from Parameters section (they are `configureActions` options, already documented in the Exports section)
- [x] Replace `setTimeout(50)` with `await Promise.resolve()` in `emitActions` for faster, more reliable story tests
- [x] Fix misleading comment on `args.api` to accurately describe actual data flow (prop passed via `render`, not context)

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * ActionLogger now supports configurable action limits with automatic removal of oldest entries when exceeded.
  * Added `clearOnStoryChange` option to control whether the Actions panel clears during story navigation.
  * Introduced `configureActions` API for global configuration of Actions settings.

* **Documentation**
  * Enhanced Actions documentation with new configuration options and usage examples.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The docs list `limit` and `clearOnStoryChange` under "Parameters" (`parameters.actions.*`), but `ActionsParameters` in code only includes `argTypesRegex`, `disable`, `handles`, and `expandLevel` (code/core/src/actions/types.ts). Since these options are applied via `configureActions`/action options (not story parameters read by the addon), consider moving them out of the Parameters section or explicitly labeling them as `configureActions` options to avoid misleading readers.

comments.author: copilot-swe-agent
comments.body: Removed `limit` and `clearOnStoryChange` from the Parameters section entirely — they were already fully documented under the `configureActions` export. Commit 7933cb4.

comments.author: copilot-pull-request-reviewer
copilot-pull-request-reviewer
comments.body: The comment on `args.api` says the decorator will override the prop "via context", but `ActionLogger` uses the `api` prop directly and the actual override happens in `render` by passing `currentApi`. Please update the comment to match the real data flow to avoid confusion for future maintainers.

comments.author: copilot-swe-agent
comments.body:
Both issues fixed in commit 1e920ca:
- `emitActions` now uses `await Promise.resolve()` instead of `setTimeout(50)` to yield to the event loop without a fixed delay
- Fixed the `args.api` comment to accurately describe that the `render` function directly passes `currentApi` as the prop, not the decorator via context
